# Recallant

> AI search visibility research and focused website improvements for B2B software brands. A specialist product from Signal & Syllable. Bengaluru, India. Contact: hello@recallant.com.

- [Services](https://recallant.com/services.html): agreed measurement, evidence-led improvements and follow-up.
- [Plans](https://recallant.com/plans.html): snapshot request, INR 14,400 pre-tax Visibility & Enquiry Pilot, scoped audit and ongoing support.
- [Method](https://recallant.com/method.html): mention rate, share of voice, citations and first-named order proxy; these do not measure revenue or verified preference.
- [Research](https://recallant.com/research.html): published study and sample.
- [Helpdesk study](https://recallant.com/helpdesk-study.html): 44 questions, 220 saved Perplexity answers collected 6 October 2026. Historical evidence, not current live search.
- [Sample](https://recallant.com/sample-snapshot.html): Freshdesk example, not a client result.
- [Contact](https://recallant.com/contact.html): choose a request and continue to the shared Signal & Syllable review-and-send form.
- [Privacy](https://recallant.com/privacy.html)
- [About](https://recallant.com/about.html)
